title: Orthogonality between acyclic subdigraphs and paths in digraphs
summary: Let $D$ be a digraph. A collection of disjoint sets of vertices (respec., collection of disjoint subdigraphs) $\mathcal{H}$ of $D$ and a vertex subset (or subdigraph) $Q$ of $D$ are orthogonal if every set (respec., subdigraph) $H \in \mathcal{H}$ contains exactly one vertex of $Q$. A well-known result of Gallai and Milgram shows that for every minimum path partition of a digraph there is a stable set orthogonal to it.
